Report that the process is up and serving requests.

patch.description: Apply only the fields present in the body.

delete.description: Delete a course together with its lectures and tasks.

get.description: List a course's lectures ordered by date, undated lectures last.

schema.title: Response List Lectures Courses  Course Id  Lectures Get

post.description:
Create a lecture from an uploaded transcript file.

Accepted: Kitzur ``.transcript.md``, raw Zoom ``.json``, ``.vtt`` and ``.txt``.
Speakers are anonymized before anything is stored.

Developer note: the body is read with a cap of MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES + 1 so an
oversized upload is detected without loading the whole file into memory.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 404 unknown course, 409 same transcript already in this
        course, 413 file too large, 415 unsupported format, 422 unusable content.

get.description: Return one lecture with its transcript.

patch.description: Rename or re-date a lecture. The transcript cannot be edited.

get.description: List a course's tasks, ordered by earliest deadline first, undated tasks last.

schema.title: Response List Tasks Courses  Course Id  Tasks Get

post.description: Create a manual task in a course.

patch.description: Apply only the fields present in the body.

post.description:
Upload a syllabus or past exam and store its extracted text.

Developer note: PDF parsing is CPU-bound and synchronous, so it runs in the
thread pool; calling it directly would block every other request while a
large PDF is parsed.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 404 unknown course, 409 same text already in this course,
        413 file too large, 415 unsupported format, 422 no usable text.

get.description: List a course's materials, newest first, optionally filtered by kind.

schema.title: Response List Materials Courses  Course Id  Materials Get

get.description: Return one material with its extracted text.

patch.description: Change the kind or display name. The extracted text cannot be edited.

post.description: Add a question to a course, optionally linked to one of its lectures.

get.description: List a course's questions with their answers, for review.

schema.title: Response List Questions Courses  Course Id  Questions Get

get.description:
Pick questions for a practice session, least practiced first.

Developer note: ordering by attempt count and then random() means a new
session covers unseen questions before repeating any, while ties are
shuffled so two sessions do not look identical.

schema.title: Response Practice Session Courses  Course Id  Practice Get

get.description: Totals over every attempt in a course.
Return one question with its answer.

delete.description: Delete a question and its attempts.

post.description:
Grade and store one answer, then reveal the solution.

Multiple choice is graded by the server against ``correct_index``; a
flashcard is self-graded with ``knew``.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 404 unknown question, 422 if the body does not match
        the question type.

AttemptCreate.title: AttemptCreate
AttemptCreate.description:
POST /questions/{id}/attempts body.

Send ``chosen_index`` for multiple choice, or ``knew`` (self-graded) for a
flashcard. The endpoint checks that the right one was sent.

QuestionPublic.title: QuestionPublic
QuestionPublic.description:
Question as shown while practising.

The correct option and explanation of a multiple choice question are left
out: the server grades the attempt and reveals them in the result. A
flashcard's answer is included because the student flips the card and
grades themselves.

Segment.title: Segment
Segment.description:
One transcript block after import: anonymized speaker plus text.

Times are seconds from the start of the recording, which keeps them sortable
and lets the frontend build a clickable topic map later.
